items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 77:1
items.html: The matter of the division of Aba and Ima and YESHSUT into two Partzufim is because of the stature of SAG in them: for, in permanence, Aba and Ima took the Bina of MAH, namely the ten Sefirot of the stature of SAG, whose upper aspect is Bina, in the light of Neshama. And they nurse from the Bina of AA, which is called the throat. And even though this Bina emerged from the head of AA, nevertheless it is discerned as GAR, because the GAR of Bina are in the secret of for He delights in mercy, and they do not bear any screen; therefore the screen in the mouth of AA does not diminish it from the aspect of head and GAR, as though it had not emerged from the head, as said in the previous parts, that there is no restriction in the light of Hassadim. And all this is said only of the GAR of Bina, which are the KHB HGT in the stature of SAG, whose way is in concealed Hassadim. But in the NHY of Bina, which are the aspects of the roots of ZON in Bina, whose way is in revealed Hassadim — meaning that the illumination of Hochma will be revealed in the Hassadim — the screen in the mouth of AA already rules over them, and they are made lacking a head, namely the aspect of VAK alone. And this is what caused the stature of SAG of Atzilut, which are Aba and Ima, to divide into two Partzufim, into Aba and Ima and YESHSUT: the GAR of the stature are Aba and Ima, whose way is in concealed Hassadim; therefore the stature of Neshama is counted for them as complete GAR, for the screen of the head of AA does not rule over them. And the aspect of the VAK of the stature of SAG, namely the chest and below of Aba and Ima, emerged in the aspect of VAK without a head, for they need revealed Hassadim, and the screen already diminishes them from the aspect of the illumination of Hochma, as long as there is in them only the aspect of SAG, because Bina emerged from the head of AA, as above. And toward revealed Hassadim, there is no aspect of GAR at all in this stature. And this is the root of the division of Aba and Ima and YESHSUT: Aba and Ima alone take the GAR of the stature, and Yeshut and Tevunah are divided from them into a Partzuf of VAK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 77:2
items.html: (To the question) And accordingly, it is understood by itself that at the time when ZON have only the stature of SAG, which is Neshama, they too are necessarily divided into two Partzufim, like Aba and Ima and YESHSUT: only his KHB HGT up to the chest receive the GAR and the aspect of a head, being the aspect of concealed Hassadim; but the chest and below is separated by itself into a Partzuf of VAK without a head, for the stature of SAG does not suffice to serve them as the aspect of a head, since they need the illumination of Hochma, as above in YESHSUT. It is thus found that when ZA is in the stature of Neshama, he is necessarily divided into two separate Partzufim: from the chest and above is the aspect of the great ZON, in the head of the Neshama; and from the chest and below is the aspect of the small ZON, which emerged by themselves in VAK without a head. (Item 83 and in the Inner Light, s.v. and afterward).
